echo_isles_fisher: Tarna Swiftwave. I fish for the Landing - or I did. The Tidal Flats to the south were the best water on these islands until the stingers and burrowers moved in and something big started eating my skiffs.
echo_isles_shaman: Spiritwalker Kesh. I keep watch over the drowned temple on this isle - the Grotto, just south-west of here. The dead inside it were Darkspear once. Some of them have not stayed where they were laid.
echo_isles_net_mender: Talra Saltbraid. I mend every net the Landing owns, and the sea ruins them faster than I can tie. Good cord is the trouble - the only hide tough enough comes off the eels out by the wrecks.
echo_isles_young_diver: Muzka. Best diver on the Echo Isles - ask anyone, or anyone who's still speaking to me. I dive the Sunken Steps north of here. My brother dove the reef to the south, once.
echo_isles_goblin_salvager: Dritt. Reef wrangler, salvage, some light piracy when the paperwork allows. There's a whole drowned fleet north of this camp and a causeway full of naga between me and it. I've got the claim. I need the muscle.
echo_isles_spirit_elder: Elder Tidecaller Vashj. I speak for the water at Echo Landing. The naga have come back to their ruins on the west isle, and the old stones there have started saying things I'd like a second pair of ears on.
echo_isles_shipwreck_bones: [Bones in the wrack, tangled in what was once rigging. Whatever ship they came off went down out by the Lost Fleet, and it is not coming back for the rest of its crew.]
echo_isles_troll_beachcomber: Jin'zil, mon. I walk da beaches after every storm - da Lost Fleet up north-east keep givin' tings up, charts and lanterns and worse. Somebody got to pick it over before da crabs do.
echo_isles_troll_healer: Zathra. I mend da village - cuts, fevers, and what Zalazane's hexes leave behind, which be da hard part. You bleedin'? No? Den you here about da hexes, and dat I got time for.
echo_isles_troll_elder: Elder Kang'ari. Dis village be what's left of da Darkspear on dese isles - Zalazane turned da rest, and dey sit in da camps just past our fires wearin' our faces. I mean to have my people back or have dem buried proper.
echo_isles_camp_quartermaster: Rask'jin, quartermaster. Echo Landing was a beach wit' a boat on it not long ago; now I got to make it a camp before da season turns. Walls, mostly. You want to help, I got a list.
echo_isles_camp_lookout: Vessa Palewind. I watch for da Landing - da tree line, da bridges, and da cultist camps across da east water. Someting move wrong out dere, I see it before it sees you.
ct_echo: Drogan. The Landing's trainer, for every discipline - they don't send a specialist out to an island camp. Show me what you've learned so far and bring coin.
pt_echo_forge: Hulda. I teach mining at the Landing. The islands have ore if you know the rock. For smithing you want the mainland - there's no proper forge on this beach.
pt_echo_herbs: Urzul. I teach herbalism - the islands grow things the mainland doesn't, and half of them will kill you if you brew them wrong. Brewing is alchemy; learn that at a real bench in Razor Hill.
pt_echo_wood: Orgha. I teach woodcutting, and Rask'jin takes every plank I can give him for his wall. The Landing's sawmill is a few steps east of me. Building with planks yourself is woodworking, and that's taught back on the mainland.
